verdict.rationale: Gemini is itself the AI assistant, and first-party docs show users delegating real tasks to it. It can take permissioned actions in connected apps, such as editing content, creating Calendar events and summarizing Gmail. It also runs scheduled recurring actions, performs multi-source Deep Research, and supports custom Gems built for specific goals. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated actions (connected-app actions, scheduled tasks) work reliably in practice.
